title: QuriOS AI: The AI learning companion for curious minds | Product Hunt
excerpt: QuriOS AI transforms textbooks into interactive learning experiences. Students can scan any page to get curriculum-aware AI tutoring, immersive 3D/AR visualizations, guided problem solving, quizzes, summaries, and personalized learning. Unlike general AI chatbots, QuriOS is built for schools with teacher analytics, classroom workflows, and syllabus-aligned learning that helps students truly understand—not just memorize.
